instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Specialized facade engineering contractor designing and installing curtain wall systems, structural glazing, and rainscreen cladding for high-rise office towers. Deep expertise in EN 13830 compliance and thermal performance modeling. Exploring parametric design tools to accelerate shop drawing generation. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market. We are actively exploring adjacent business models — potentially a marketplace, a subscription-based service layer, or a data monetization play built on the proprietary data we already collect. We are willing to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines with seed funding to test viability.

fields.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 7 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Establish a Data-Driven Service Marketplace Platform
opportunities.rationale: The company is explicitly seeking diversification, and its core asset is proprietary operational data (IoT/Facade performance). Moving beyond simple service contracting to creating a platform that monetizes this data or connects specialized contractors represents a major structural shift. This requires developing entirely new business models.

first_actions: Engage external consultants specializing in industry-specific marketplaces (e.g., construction tech).
Develop Minimum Viable Product (MVP) scope focusing on the most valuable data stream (e.g., thermal performance gaps vs. actual usage).
Create a formal 'Incubation' budget and dedicated small team for experimental testing.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Seed funding commitment for 1-2 year incubation period.
Data science expertise (internal or external hire/consultancy).
Legal counsel specializing in data monetization and compliance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful completion of a pilot transaction using the marketplace model, achieving >5% revenue contribution from the new stream within 18 months.
milestones: Beta market launch with initial paying partners (Q2 next year).

opportunities.title: Formalize Multi-Jurisdictional Compliance and Data Auditing Processes
opportunities.rationale: Given the 'high' regulatory environment (EN 13830) and increasing data complexity from IoT/parametric tools, standardizing a robust internal compliance framework is critical. This mitigates risk associated with both scaling and new market entry.

first_actions: Map all current operational data flows (IoT, design specs) against relevant EN standards and regional regulations.
Designate a dedicated Compliance Officer/Team Lead responsible for maintaining the framework lifecycle.
Implement mandatory internal audit checkpoints before any new service model or technology investment is deployed.
resources_needed: Access to legal counsel specializing in construction/engineering standards.
Process mapping software or methodology training.
execution_plan.success_metric: Zero critical findings during the first internal audit cycle, and a fully documented 'Compliance Checkpoint' gate integrated into strategic planning.
milestones: New process documentation approved by leadership (Q4).
Training modules rolled out to all operational staff (Q1 next year).

next_steps.action: Establish an Innovation Steering Committee (ISC) comprising senior leaders to govern the incubation budget and prioritize between diversification tracks.
Finalize and manage vendor integration for the full IoT fleet rollout, prioritizing API standardization to ensure seamless data flow into the core maintenance system.
Draft a formal internal proposal defining success criteria and required resources for the 'Marketplace' opportunity, initiating initial budget discussions.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on proprietary operational data without an immediately scalable monetization mechanism.
Decentralized decision authority despite professionalization, risking process inconsistencies across new departments.
Complexity gap in integrating advanced digital tools (parametric design, IoT) with legacy business processes.

improvements: Successful transition from founder-led to formalized, multi-senior management structure.
Digital Maturity increased from 2 to 3, demonstrating foundational technical capacity improvements.
Initial proof-of-concept for IoT deployment achieved, validating a clear business case for full fleet rollout.
persistent_gaps: Translating operational process improvement (IoT) into structural revenue diversification remains complex and requires strategic governance.
The organizational structure needs to move beyond just hiring leaders; formal cross-functional decision protocols must be embedded in daily operations.
Securing specialized technical expertise for data monetization modeling.
achieved_milestones: Formal business case approved for full IoT fleet rollout (key operational milestone).
Strategic planning process has moved beyond conceptual stage and is actively being formalized by senior leadership team.
Core leadership team successfully hired, increasing institutional knowledge base.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant organizational maturation and digital uplift (Maturity 2 -> 3). The shift to professional management significantly de-risked the operational foundation, enabling ambitious diversification goals.
